entry.description: Guesses a vowel in an unstressed syllable inside a word: regester for register. Scoped to the ERROR. Distinct from en-unstressed-suffix-vowel, whose vowel surfaces when the stress shifts (definite/definition); a medial vowel has no family word that stresses it, so the remediation is the spelling pattern — minister, sinister, register.
